alerts.title: Cadillac Summit Road closed to all users Nov 9-25 and Dec 1-18
alerts.description: Starting Nov 9, construction will resume for an accessible pedestrian path between the East and West parking lots on the summit of Cadillac Mountain. Cadillac Summit Road will be closed to all users (including bicyclists and pedestrians) Nov 9-25 and Dec 1-18. Hiking trails on Cadillac Mountain will remain open. NOTE: Park Loop Road will close to motor vehicles for the season Dec 1, except for access to Jordan Pond via Jordan Pond Road in Seal Harbor, and access to Sand Beach via Schooner Head Road.

alerts.title: Eastern Section of Beech Mountain Loop Trail Closed for Repairs
alerts.description: Starting Sept 21, the eastern section of the Beech Mountain Loop Trail will be closed for repairs from a junction just beyond the parking lot to just below the summit at the fire tower. Three alternate routes to the summit are available: the outer loop of the Beech Mountain Loop Trail, Beech South Ridge Trail and Beech West Ridge Trail.
